summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metre rounding half away from zero) and 0013 (full_name without concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40.1 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 for collectors, deferred taxon load, all five basis codes). A fresh build passes all checks and exports, and an upgraded copy of the 1.6.0 database matches it in schema and rows.
